plans.note: Sections 9.1 and 9.2 are the paired liability caps; check cap amount/formula, mutuality, consequential damages exclusion and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP). Section 5.4 Other Disclaimers and 14.2 Survival may add related exclusions.

8.1 is IBM's indemnity (test IP infringement plus misconduct scope); 8.2 is our indemnity — confirm it stays narrow. sec-1 appears to be the indemnity procedure conditions (prompt notice, control of defense). Check whether indemnity is carved out of the 9.1 cap.

14.16 Freedom of Action typically confirms both parties may compete/serve others; verify it imposes no restraint on us. 14.11 No Resale and 13.2 Acceptable Use Policy could contain incidental business restrictions. Likely no true non-compete.
Scan Freedom of Action, No Resale and the Services/License scope for any sole-source or exclusive-provider language binding Bluefly; hosting agreements of this type usually have none.
Check Charges and Payment (and Amendments to pricing) for any best-price/most-favoured-customer undertaking running against us; MFN clauses are rare in IBM standard hosting terms.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home of any hiring/solicitation restriction; test duration, mutuality and whether general advertising and unsolicited applicants are carved out.

3.4 is the core termination-for-convenience clause: check notice length, whether it is mutual (IBM should not be able to walk mid-term) and any termination charges. 3.5 Effect of Termination and 4.1 Charges may impose early-termination fees.
3.2 Renewal governs auto-renewal length and non-renewal notice window; 3.1 Term sets the initial period and 4.1 may govern renewal-term price uplifts.

14.3 Choice of Law is dispositive; confirm an accepted jurisdiction and courts rather than foreign arbitration. 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period (limitation on time to sue) are related but separate points to note.
14.10 Assignment: check for our right to assign to affiliates/successors without consent and whether IBM may terminate on our change of control or assign freely.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses set IP ownership boundaries; 11.6 Content and Digital Certificates and 14.18 Data Protection should confirm we retain ownership of our content/data with no assignment to IBM.
12.1 is the grant: test scope for affiliate and contractor use, non-revocability during term, and whether 14.17/14.11 narrow it (no resale, no sublicense).

11.3 Suspected Violations is the most likely inspection/verification right against us; check notice, frequency, scope and cost allocation. 11.5 Capacity Planning and 13.2 AUP may include usage monitoring.
Look for late-payment interest, early-termination or overage penalties payable by us in 4.2 and 3.5; service credits in our favour are acceptable and should not be flagged.

5.1 sets IBM's warranties and 11.1 Services Support the service-level remedy; 5.2 Exclusivity of Warranties and 5.4 Other Disclaimers likely disclaim all implied warranties — assess whether a meaningful performance warranty and remedy survive. 11.2 is our warranty, not IBM's.
No insurance heading appears in the outline; check Risk of Loss (14.12) and Security (5.3) for any coverage undertaking before recording as missing.
4.1 Charges (with Order Forms) is where any minimum/committed volume or take-or-pay would sit; 11.5 Capacity Planning may impose committed capacity. Pair with 3.4 to confirm an exit exists.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the natural home for data return and migration assistance; check 14.18 Data Protection and 11.6 Content for retrieval/deletion mechanics and whether any wind-down period is specified.
